Cycle cabinet heaters (7) and unit heaters (2) 20 minutes every 30 minute. Cycle through half of variable air volume (VAV)/Air terminal boxes (75) and AHU fans (4) every half hour. Set CO2 setpoint up by 200 ppm. Turn off hot water panel radiator.
